audio.content: ambient sound design only, CC0 or synthesised

tank.water_level: about 3 cm below the rim, below the light clamp

render_method: Blender 4.5 LTS, Cycles on GPU (OptiX), headless Python scripts

scapes.title: Iwagumi
scapes.summary: Odd group of grey Seiryu-style stones sized to the tank (main stone about two fifths of the water depth), hairgrass carpet, open water

scapes.title: Dutch garden
scapes.summary: Stem plants in greens, reds and pinks in irregular interlocking drifts of mixed height around an open bay of water

scapes.title: Mountain
scapes.summary: Ridges of warm jagged stone, a pale sand valley receding between them, moss and fine carpet on the lower slopes

scapes.title: Forest
scapes.summary: Driftwood trees, each one different in trunk, branching and foliage, unevenly placed along a winding sand path

scapes.title: Riverbed
scapes.summary: Rounded river stones graded from boulders to gravel as a current would leave them, ribbon grass bent in the flow, very open water

scapes.title: Jungle
scapes.summary: Overgrown nano jungle: mixed leaf shapes and sizes, wood reaching to the surface, floating plants, a clearing of open water

scapes.title: Blackwater Amazon
scapes.summary: Weak-tea water, roots, leaf litter, floating plants, warm light

scapes.title: Lotus pond
scapes.summary: Red tiger lotus: thin stalks rising to lily pads on the surface, dappled shade on a dark bed

scapes.title: Cove
scapes.summary: Golden rock walls meeting in a natural arch over a pale sand beach, moss and small epiphytes in the cracks

scapes.title: Floating Islands
scapes.summary: A few small moss-covered rocks hanging well apart in mid water with roots, white sand, a thin sand-fall

captions.placement: [ASSUMED: clean floor area below the tank, soft fades, open-licence font]

camera.solve: OpenCV solvePnP against the 30 cm cube corners; RMS reprojection error 2 px or less
camera.moves: small real dolly or arc per scape over a projection-mapped rebuild of the room, limited so the projection does not tear

pipeline.does: tonemap, clean lit plate, grain profile, camera solve, masks
room proxy, tank, water, light, assets, scapes, animation, render
merge over plate, grain match, captions, audio, encode

storage.repo: code, config, review stills, committed clip without audio, final video
storage.work_dir: config/paths.json (outside OneDrive): downloaded assets, frame sequences, caches

assets_policy: CC0 only; each listed in assets/MANIFEST.md with source URL

orchestration.subagents: Opus 5.5 for bounded tasks, one task each, verified by the coordinator before commit
owner_gates: G2 ten design stills (blocks final render per scape)
orchestration.resume: progress_tracking.json ledger plus a 30 minute heartbeat scheduled in the session

shoal.simulation: src/sim/school.py, one run for the whole film
shoal.per_scape_water: SWIM literal in each scape module
shoal.continuity: the same fish on the same path in every scape, so a dissolve between scapes leaves the fish where they are
